mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, me.name AS my_name, partner.name AS partner_name, c.profile_message FROM couple c INNER JOIN member me ON me.id = #{memberId} AND me.status = 'ACTIVE' AND me.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN member partner ON partner.id = CASE WHEN c.inviter_id = #{memberId} THEN c.invitee_id ELSE c.inviter_id END AND partner.status = 'ACTIVE' AND partner.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}

SELECT c.id AS couple_id, c.inviter_id, c.invitee_id, c.invitation_code_id, ic.common_survey_id FROM couple c INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id WHERE c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM personal_recommendation_tax_saving WHERE member_id IN (#{inviterId}, #{inviteeId})
DELETE FROM personal_recommendation_investment WHERE member_id IN (#{inviterId}, #{inviteeId})
mapper.select: SELECT name FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ic.id AS invitation_code_id, ic.common_survey_id, cs.member_id AS inviter_id, ic.status FROM invitation_code ic INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE ic.code_value = #{inviteCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM member WHERE id IN (#{firstMemberId}, #{secondMemberId}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE ic FROM invitation_code ic INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = ic.common_survey_id WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId}
DELETE psie FROM personal_survey_investment_experience psie INNER JOIN personal_survey ps ON ps.id = psie.personal_survey_id WHERE ps.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET investment_type = NULL, recommendation_input_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{memberId} AND investment_type IS NOT NULL
UPDATE invitation_code SET status = 'USED' WHERE id = #{invitationCodeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
